description: Cutting utilities, failing to carry out repairs, verbal harassment, repeated entry without notice, and threats of financial injury such as reporting to a credit bureau or refusing a reference.
energy_note: Nothing illegal individually. All of it, deliberately.

aspect: The motive is usually the rent, not the tenant
description: Many cases arise where a landlord wants a lower-paying tenant out in favour of a higher-paying one - so it is economic and not personal, which makes it systematic.
energy_note: Not about her. About the difference in rent.

aspect: Even a buyout can be coercive
description: Offers of payment accompanied by threats or intimidation are prohibited in some jurisdictions precisely because the offer and the pressure arrive together.
energy_note: An offer, with the pressure attached.

description: Monthly, then fortnightly. Always with notice, always exactly 24 hours. He photographs the kitchen each time 'for the file'. Nothing is ever found and he never mentions leaving.
energy_note: Entirely lawful, fortnightly, with a camera.
